data.title: Concept 7 Residences
data.about:
Welcome to Concept 7 Residences at JVC by Condor, where life takes a fresh perspective. It's more than a building; it's a whole new way of living. At Concept 7, we believe life is an exhilarating adventure, with each moment offering the chance to embrace new experiences.

Experience Concept 7 Residences in JVC, offering furnished cozy studios, 1 & 2-bedroom apartments.. Enjoy seven days of comfortable living with fitness facilities and a large swimming pool. Your dream furnished living is now within reach, backed by unwavering commitment to quality.

At Concept 7, your pets are as welcome as you are, ensuring an inclusive community for all. Make the choice where your furnished living dreams become a reality, where excellence meets style, and every moment is perfected.

characteristics_module.title: A Vibrant Living Experience at Concept 7
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Diverse Apartments: Choose from 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and studios.
  • Wellness Hub: Fitness floor and large swimming pool for workouts and relaxation.
  • Quality Assurance: Uncompromising quality in materials and craftsmanship.
  • Stylish Interiors: Vibrant interiors that make your space uniquely yours.
  • Spacious Rooms: Comfortable living spaces.
  • Premium Fixtures: High-quality fittings and finishes.
  • Fully Furnished: Turnkey, fully furnished, and fully equipped.
  • Strategic Location: Located in the sought-after Jumeirah Village Circle with amenities and green spaces.
  • High Rental Income: Great rental income potential.
  • Green Parks: Multiple parks and playgrounds for recreation.
  • Pet-Friendly Amenities: Dog parks and pet-friendly cafes for pet owners.

location_tile.title: A New Concept 7 in Jumeirah Village Circle
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Discover unparalleled convenience in Jumeirah Village Circle. You're just moments away from The Circle Mall and Jumeirah Village Circle Park, offering a delightful mix of shopping, dining, and outdoor leisure. With 30 beautifully planned parks, 18 children's play areas, jogging tracks, and a forthcoming cycling track, this district is tailor-made for your active lifestyle. Benefiting from a strategic location, Concept 7 offers the ideal setting for a hassle-free lifestyle. It's a mere 15-minute drive from Al Maktoum International Airport and just 29 minutes from Dubai International Airport.

  • Circle Mall 01 minutes 
  • Dubai Marina 18 minutes
  • Burj - Khalifa 20 minutes 
  • Business Bay 20 minutes
  • Motor City 05 minutes
  • Mall of the Emirates 15 minutes
  • City Center Me’aisem 10 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport 29 minutes
